name: Asuhara Chidori
source: Only male child of Asuhara family and best friends with protagonist. Despite picking up cross dressing habit is still the same person the protagonist remembers when he left.  Is mostly the straight man in game often pointing the more stupid or silliness of other characters.  Even though he is usual complaining he is one of the more insightful characters that does care about friends and family.
